spans.s:
m. (-ञ्चः)
1 A kind of heron, (Ardea jaculator, BUC.)
2 One of the Dvīpas or principal divisions of the world, surrounded by the sea of curds.
3 A mountain, part of the Himāla range, situated in the eastern part of the chain on the north of

A Jaina emblem, the figure of the curlew, used as a symbol.
5 The name of a demon.
f. (-ञ्चा)
The female of the curlew.
E.
क्रुञ्च to go crookedly, affix अण्.

m. (-णः)
A name of KĀRTTIKEYA.
E.
क्रौञ्च the name of a mountain; also of an Asura, and दारण the tearer or destroyer.

m. (-नः)
1 Long pepper.
2 The fibres of the stalk of the lotus.
3 An esculent root, commonly

An aquatic plant, commonly Ciñcāta.
E.
क्रौञ्च the heron, and अदन eating.

m. (-तिः)
A name of KĀRTTIKEYA. क्रौञ्च the Asura, and अराति an enemy.

The hero and Avatāra PARAŚURĀMA.
E.
क्रौञ्च the Asura or the mountain, and अरि a foe: RĀMA is said to have made with his arrows a pass or defile through the Krauncha mountain.

n. (-र्य्यं)
Cruelty, fierceness, passion.
E.
क्रूर cruel, &c. य्यञ् aff.

m. (-कः)
One who goes a hundred Koś or leagues.
E.
क्रोश a Koś, शत a hundred, and ठञ् aff.
